title: UNL Cost of Attendance
text:
Content
An important part of preparing for college is understanding the avenues available for managing expenses. We can help you plan for college, estimate your cost of attendance, calculate your estimated tuition cost and get connected with food and housing security resources.

title: UNL Cost of Attendance
text:
Planning for College
The University of Nebraska–Lincoln has been consistently designated as a best buy, best value, or most affordable comprehensive national university. Nebraska takes great pride in our academic excellence, student life and affordability.

title: UNL Cost of Attendance
text:
Estimated Cost of Attendance
The estimated cost of attendance (COA) is a standardized estimate of the comprehensive cost of being a student at Nebraska for a specific enrollment period. It includes tuition and fees, housing and food, books and supplies and allowances for transportation, personal expenses and loan fees.

title: UNL Cost of Attendance
text:
University Housing Application
The on-campus living experience at Nebraska can't be beat. University Housing offers safe and secure living options with convenient access to university resources, such as the campus library and laboratories.

title: UNL Cost of Attendance
text:
Residency
Nebraska residents are assessed in-state tuition, and out-of-state students are assessed at a higher rate. If you are an out-of-state student, you may qualify for scholarships to balance the cost of tuition.

title: UNL Cost of Attendance
text:
Food and Housing Security
Nebraska provides resources to help support students experiencing food or housing insecurity, as well as options for emergency financial aid.

title: UNL Cost of Attendance
text:
Net Price Calculator
Net Price is the amount that a student pays to attend an institution in a single academic year after subtracting scholarships and grants. Net Price Calculators help students estimate what tuition might cost after scholarships and grants.

title: UNL Cost of Attendance
text:
Husker Payment Plan
The Husker Payment Plan is a payment option made available by the Bursar's Office that allows enrolled students to pay their fall and spring charges in monthly payments.
